in_marathi.name: Sanmita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanmita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanmita is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words: San (God) and Mita (Goddess of Prosperity). The name Sanmita signifies the presence of both God and Goddess of Prosperity, representing abundance, wealth, and happiness.
